d: The AI/ML Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. The role translates operational and business requirements into secure, scalable, and measurable AI capabilities, including predictive analytics, intelligent automation, natural language processing, computer vision, and Generative AI. Responsibilities cover the full AI/ML lifecycle, from data preparation and experimentation through production deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage.
3+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with practical experience using scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Solid understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, model evaluation, and statistical methods.
Experience with cloud AI/ML services, preferably Microsoft Azure, Oracle OCI and with REST APIs, Git, Docker, CI/CD, and model monitoring.
Practical exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, NLP, computer vision, or intelligent document processing.
Knowledge of MLOps tools and practices, including experiment tracking, model registry, data/model versioning, automated testing, deployment, and drift monitoring.
Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, cybersecurity, explainability, governance, and regulatory or audit requirements.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
r: Identify and assess high-value AI/ML use cases in collaboration with business and operational stakeholders.
Collect, clean, transform, and validate structured and unstructured data for model development.
Design, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for prediction, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, NLP, and computer vision.
Develop Generative AI solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Build reusable AI services and integrate models with enterprise applications through secure APIs and event-driven interfaces.
Deploy AI/ML models to on-premises or cloud environments using containerization, model-serving, and CI/CD practices.
Build and maintain automated pipelines for data preparation, training, testing, versioning, approval, deployment, and retraining.
Monitor model accuracy, drift, bias, latency, availability, security, and infrastructure cost, and implement corrective actions.
Maintain model documentation, traceability, audit evidence, access controls, and responsible AI controls covering privacy, fairness, explainability, and human oversight.
Hands-on experience with open-source LLMs, including model optimization, fine-tuning, token and model-size management, and development of secure internal chatbots for enterprise use cases.

Strong ability to understand business requirements, collaborate with business owners and key stakeholders, and translate business needs into AI solutions supported by appropriate governance, security, and access-control frameworks.
Work with business teams, data owners, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams to define requirements, success measures, and operating controls.
Communicate model assumptions, performance, limitations, and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Prepare technical documentation, deployment guides, support procedures, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.

d: Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
q: 8+ years of audit experience, with proven capability to step into a regulatory Key Function Holder role.
Deep knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements in the UAE, including relevant CBUAE, DFSA or FSRA frameworks.
Experience auditing financial crime, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, payment systems, card schemes, customer money safeguarding or enterprise risk management.
Experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of controls.
Experience communicating complex risks and audit findings clearly to senior stakeholders, Boards and regulators.
Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels.
A bachelor's degree or above in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
Current UAE residency with valid work authorisation, or eligibility for UAE employment visa sponsorship and willingness to relocate to meet applicable regulatory presence requirements.
Professional audit qualifications such as CIA, CPA, CAMS, CISA or FRM.
Hands-on experience with data analysis tools such as Python, Databricks, Looker or SQL.
Experience using AI-driven audit methodologies or building automated monitoring routines.
Experience working in a high-growth, international fintech or other highly regulated business.
r: You'll establish and lead the internal audit function for Airwallex's UAE entity, meeting local regulatory expectations while supporting the entity's growth. You'll work across the UAE, EMEA and Airwallex's international footprint to strengthen assurance, controls and regulatory readiness.
Establish and lead the internal audit function for Airwallex's UAE entity, meeting local regulatory expectations and supporting the entity's growth.
Serve as the designated Chief Internal Auditor / Head of Internal Audit and Key Function Holder for the UAE entity, partnering with the local Board and relevant regulators.
Design and execute risk-based audit plans, charters and testing procedures tailored to the UAE regulatory environment and Airwallex's local risk profile.
Lead regulatory compliance audits across the EMEA region and contribute to global compliance audits across Airwallex's international footprint.

Assess the design and operating effectiveness of controls across financial crime, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, payment systems, card schemes, customer money safeguarding and enterprise risk management.
Use data analytics and technology to improve audit efficiency, support continuous monitoring and identify emerging risks or anomalies.
Communicate complex compliance issues clearly to senior management, business leaders, risk teams, Boards and regulators.
Track management action plans and follow up to ensure audit findings are remediated in a timely and sustainable way.
Stay close to regulatory developments across the UAE and broader EMEA region, embedding relevant changes and best practices into Airwallex's audit approach.
You'll work from our Dubai or Abu Dhabi office three days a week.
You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.
You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.
You've operated in a compliance-heavy environment and know how to move fast without cutting the corners that matter.
You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.
You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.
You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Internal Audit reviews how our business operates end to end, identifying risks, surfacing gaps, and uncovering opportunities to build stronger controls. It's a function for people with the highest standards and sharp judgment who want their work to have real influence, not just flagging issues, but helping shape a more resilient business as Airwallex grows. If you want to do rigorous work with high visibility and help raise the bar on how global fintech scales, this is the place to do it.
Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
